Reranking where NVIDIA NIM lists the scored documents under rankings with a logit

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	pkg "github.com/xberg-io/liter-llm/packages/go/v2"
)

func main() {
	req := pkg.RerankRequest{
		Model:     `nvidia_nim/nv-rerankqa`,
		Query:     `What is machine learning?`,
		Documents: []pkg.RerankDocument{pkg.RerankDocumentText{Value: `The weather is sunny today.`}, pkg.RerankDocumentText{Value: `Deep learning uses neural networks.`}, pkg.RerankDocumentText{Value: `Machine learning is a subset of AI.`}},
	}
	client, clientErr := pkg.CreateClient("your-api-key", nil, nil, nil, nil)
	if clientErr != nil {
		panic(clientErr)
	}
	defer client.Free()
	result, err := client.Rerank(req)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Results)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Results[0].RelevanceScore)
}
```
